report.summary: Verified two claims: case-insensitivity missing in rebase_declared_path (CONFIRMED, risk on Windows); no warning on unexpected rebase failure (CONFIRMED, OSError not caught).
risks: CONFIRMED rebase_declared_path does not normalize path case before relative_to comparison, which will fail on Windows when the resolved path and primary_root differ in case but are logically the same.

CONFIRMED rebase_declared_path does not warn when rebase fails unexpectedly; specifically, it catches ValueError but not OSError from p.resolve() if the path does not exist, leading to unhandled exceptions.
todos: Add case normalization to rebase_declared_path: e.g., compare os.path.normcase of resolved paths or use a case-insensitive relative_to alternative.
Catch OSError in rebase_declared_path and emit a warning via logging.warning before returning the raw path, or raise a more descriptive exception.
